subject.title: fix(android): keep composer media with its chat

question: Should Android upgrades intentionally park legacy outbox rows whose original agent owner cannot be proven, requiring manual re-entry or deletion instead of automatic retry?
rationale: The safe technical default avoids cross-agent delivery, but it deliberately changes shipped recovery behavior and imposes user action on existing persisted rows.

options.title: Approve fail-closed recovery
options.body: Keep ownerless rows visible but non-retryable, then merge after the refreshed exact-head Android checks pass.

options.title: Add a provable owner migration
options.body: Allow automatic retry only for legacy rows whose original agent can be derived and verified without guessing.

options.title: Defer durable-state expansion
options.body: Narrow this PR to transient composer ownership and handle cache/outbox migration in separately reviewed upgrade work.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed recovery
recommendation.body: Keep ownerless rows visible but non-retryable, then merge after the refreshed exact-head Android checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the branch-wide ownership expansion and is best positioned to confirm the intended Android upgrade contract.
